## Bannerlord CPU Optimizer v0.1.2

This profiler-only maintenance release fixes a TOR campaign startup crash introduced by early profiler attachment.

- Defers all `TORCustomResourceModel` profiler targets until campaign startup has completed.
- Prevents Harmony from triggering the model's localized-text static initializer during submodule loading.
- Preserves profiling of the resource model by attaching its targets on the first campaign application tick.
- Includes compiler-generated methods belonging to the same model family in the deferred set.
- Adds release gates that verify the unsafe type family cannot reach Harmony before campaign readiness.
- Keeps every other profiler target, sampling rate, report format, and gameplay invariant unchanged.

The module remains profiler-only and applies no gameplay optimization patches.
